Remove subtitles, captions, and related text occlusions from the video, restoring a clean and natural underlying image.

根据需求切换 提示词和lora

---------------------------
▶去字幕（字幕移除和文本叠加清理）
▶ltx2.3-ic-subtitles-remove-general.safetensors	
●提示词
Remove subtitles, captions, and related text occlusions from the video, restoring a clean and natural underlying image. 

---------------------------
▶去水印（水印去除和遮挡感知重建）
▶ltx2.3-ic-watermark-remove-general.safetensors	
●提示词
Remove short-video platform watermarks and related occlusions from the video, restoring a clean, clear, and natural original image.
去除视频画面中的短视频平台水印与字幕与相关遮挡痕迹，恢复干净、清晰、自然的原始画面；保持人物、场景、动作、镜头运动、时序和整体风格一致，不改变原视频内容，只进行水印和字幕的去除与细节修复。

---------------------------
▶高清化（视频高清增强、超分辨率和细节恢复）
▶ltx2.3-ic-video-upscale-general.safetensors
●提示词
Convert the video to ultra-high-definition quality, significantly improving clarity, fine detail richness, texture fidelity, and overall perceptual sharpness.
将视频转换为超高清画质，大幅提升画面清晰度与细节丰富度，增强色彩表现力与纹理细节。

---------------------------
▶去模糊（视频修复、伪影清除、模糊和噪点恢复）
▶ltx2.3-video-restoration-general.safetensors	
●提示词
Convert the video to ultra-high-definition quality while removing artifacts and rebuilding high-frequency details.
将视频转换为超高清画质，在消除伪影的同时重建高频细节，显著提升画面清晰度。
